text:
Aisha: Quick check — Sable9B intake: where are we on licensing + perf profile? Need to confirm before catalog launch this week.
Marco: I ran the perf suite on staging, 95th p50 is fine but p99 spikes on long prompts. Uploading traces to /s3/sable9b/traces.
Riley: Can you paste the failing trace id? I can look at kernel selection and batching config.
Marco: trace id: sable9b-202611-pt2. Looks like KV-cache is thrashing on 4k sequences.
Samir: infra note — dedicated pool currently using gpus with older cu kernels. We can spin up a test node with cudnn 9.2 for probing, ETA ~2h.
Aisha: Good catch. @Nadia do we have legal signoff on the license (Apache-variant w/ attribution)? I thought there was an open clause to confirm.
Nadia: LegalBot note: license review in progress. Need model weights provenance doc and third-party data attestations. I requested both from the curator earlier — pinged again.
Aisha: Ok, timeline: if infra test + legal come back today, we can cut the catalog entry tomorrow. Otherwise punt to Monday. Who owns the catalog PR?
Riley: I can own the PR (draft ready). Will add perf profile + fallback variant. Need a code review from Marco for the kernel tuning diff.
Marco: happy to CR but I'm on oncall until 5pm PT. If you tag me I’ll prioritize.
Samir: CI-bot: build failed on sable9b-infer-handler: flake8 errors in handler.py (unused import).
Riley: fixing linter now — small. Will push patch and re-run CI.
CI-bot: pipeline queued — re-run will start once patch lands.
Aisha: Final ownership: Riley PR owner, Marco CR, Samir infra test, Nadia legal. I'll do launch checklist once all green. Please update the catalog intake doc (link: https://internal.redwood/sable9b-intake) with timings.
Nadia: FYI legal ETA ~6 hours once provenance arrives.
Marco: added comments on PR and flagged the kernel change; also added a perf note recommending sequence bucketing.
Riley: pushed fix and updated intake doc. Tagging Marco for review: @Marco
Aisha: Thanks — if anyone hits a blocker call out ASAP. :thumbsup:
